description: Generate a complete, runnable TypeScript MCP server project from an OpenAPI or Postman spec. Writes the project to outputDir. Use force to overwrite a non-empty directory.

auth.description: Auth to use when the spec declares no security schemes of its own. Applied only to operations whose own security list is empty; credentials are read from env vars as usual.

excludeOperations.description: Drop operations by operationId, tool name, or tag.

format.description: Force a format; defaults to auto-detect.

includeTags.description: Keep only operations with these tags.

methods.description: Keep only these HTTP methods, e.g. [GET, POST].

outputDir.description: Directory to write the generated project into.

pythonVariant.description: Python server flavor (requires language: python): the low-level MCP SDK (default) or FastMCP. Both serve the same raw JSON-Schema tool inputs.

serverName.description: npm/package name; defaults from the API title.

spec.description: Inline spec text (OpenAPI or Postman; JSON or YAML).

specPath.description: Path to a local spec file (JSON or YAML).

toolCatalog.description: Also write tool-catalog.json (name/summary/tags per tool) for discovery layers.

transport.description: Transport(s) to generate (TypeScript only). Defaults to stdio.

name: generate_mcp_server
title: Generate MCP server
